verdict.rationale: Document QnA documents natural-language interaction with document content: users ask questions in plain language and get extracted information. Annotations also accept user requests such as captioning figures. However, the product itself is configured through structured API parameters (table_format, include_blocks, annotation formats), not natural-language commands. missing for 10: natural-language control of OCR/extraction settings and workflows beyond Q&A, a documented conversational or agent interface for operating the product, independent hands-on corroboration of NL operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Document QnA capability combines OCR with large language model capabilities to enable natural language interaction with document content.
This allows you to extract information and insights from documents by asking questions in natural language.
The user may ask to describe/caption the figure for instance.
